Why Is Aluminum Paint Mixed Fresh Before Use? ✨🎨

Ever wondered why aluminum paint doesn’t come pre-mixed from the store? 🤔

Aluminum powder and varnish are kept separate because if they are mixed and stored for too long, the aluminum particles can settle at the bottom and form a layer. When freshly mixed, the aluminum particles float toward the surface, a property known as “leafing behavior,” which gives the paint its characteristic metallic shine.
